strings.Select every download in this list (clic: Khetha wonke amafayela alayishiwe kulolu hlu (chofoza futhi ukuze ungakhethi)
strings.Download files from a website section: Layisha phezulu amafayela kusuka kungxenyekazi yewebhu
strings.Click Add URL, paste a link, drop one on: Chofoza Faka URL, chofoza ikhonkco, cindezela enye kulefasitela, noma ufake kusuka ku-browser yakho nge-extension.
strings.The new language is used after the app r: Ulimi olusha lusetshenziswa ngemuva kokuqalwa kabusha kwesicelo.
strings.Downloads, videos and torrents use only: Ukulayisha ezantsi, amavidiyo nama-torrents asebenzisa kuphela le-adaptha (njenge-VPN yakho). Uma iqhathaniswa, ukulayisha ngezansi kuyeka endaweni yokusebenzisa enye inxusa.
strings.Torrent blocklist: a file or an https://: Torrent blocklist: a file or an https:// address (empty = none)
strings.Torrents never connect to the addresses: Ama-torrents angeke axhumeke kumakheli kulolu hlu. P2P, DAT kanye nama-CIDR asebenza, futhi njenge-.gz. Ikheli lilayishwe phansi kabili ngosuku.
strings.New items of these feeds are downloaded: Izinto ezintsha zalezi zithako zilayishwe uma isihloko sazo sifana nemithetho: amafayela namavidiyo, nama-torrents uma ama-torrents ekhona. Imithetho ikhombisa amagama adingekayo wonke esihlokoni, noma /umbono ojwayelekile/.
strings.Download items whose title has all of th: Layisha ngezansi izinto ezinesihloko esiqukethe wonke la mazwi (engenalutho = yonke into)
strings.Skip items whose title has any of these: Lahla izinto ezinesihloko esiqukethe noma iyiphi yalezi zinto
strings.Check every (minutes, 15 or more): Khangela ngaso sonke isikhathi (imizuzu, 15 noma ngaphezulu)
strings.Only download items that appear after th: Lawula kuphela izinto ezivela ngemuva kokufaka umngenisi
strings.The feed address must start with http://: Ikheli le-feed kumele liqale nge http:// noma https://
strings.While I use the computer, limit download: Uma ngisebenzisa ikhompyutha, khawulela ukulayisha phezulu ku-KB/s (0 = off)
strings.Full speed again after a minute without: Isivinini esigcwele futhi ngemuva komzuzu ngaphandle kwekhibhodi noma ingxoxo yegundane.
strings.Sites whose links go through it (comma s: Izixhumanisi ezihamba ngaso (zihlukaniswe nge-comma, eg. example-host.com)
strings.Off by default. Uses your own account; l: Ikhubazekile ngokuzenzakalela. Isebenzisa i-akhawunti yakho; amakhonkco asuka kwezinye izizinda awathunyelwa inkonzoni. Isitshixo sigcinwa ngokufihliwe futhi akufanele sigcinwe kuma-backup.
strings.Download limit: at most this many MB (0: Layisha phezulu umkhawulo: ngaphezu kwalokhu MB (0 = akukho umkhawulo)
strings.… every this many hours: … ngaso sonke isikhathi lezi zinsuku eziningi
strings.When the amount is reached, downloads st: Uma inani lifinyelelwa, ukulayisha phezulu kuyeka futhi kuqhubekela phambili ngokuzimela uma isikhathi esilandelayo siqala.
strings.Enter the proxy script's web address (ht: Ngenisa ikheli le-web leskripti lomqondisi (http:// noma https://) noma indlela ephelele yehele.
strings.Proxy address (for a proxy script: its w: Idilesi yesigcini sethutyana (iskripti sesigcini sethutyana: idilesi ye-web noma ifayela)
strings.Unpack a package's archives when all of: Khipha ingobo yomlando yephakethe uma konke kuqediwe
strings.Paste text with links, or a web page add: Ncamashi umbhalo onezixhumanisi, noma ikheli lekhasi le-web bese ucindezela Thola Izixhumanisi. Ingxenye yovimba ohlukanisiwe iqoqwa ibe yiphakheji eyodwa.
strings.Save the whole gallery with the gallery: Gcina i-gallery yonke ngenjini ye-gallery (izizinda ezifana ne-Reddit, Pixiv, DeviantArt, Imgur; i-engine ilayishwe kuqala)
strings.Start the Add window in the folder I use: Qala ifasitela Lokungeza kwifolda engingayisebenzisa isikhathi sokugcina
strings.Wake the computer from sleep to start: Yivule isiga-nyezi kusuka embhedeni ukuze iqale
strings.Uses a Windows wake timer; Power Options: Isebenzisa i-Windows wake timer; Izinketho ze-Energy kumele zivumele i-wake timers. Isicelo kumele sisebenze (kungaba ku-trey).
strings.Converting needs FFmpeg. MP3 uses the be: Ukuguqula kudinga i-FFmpeg. I-MP3 isebenzisa ubunjani obushintshayo obungcono kakhulu; i-FLAC igcina yonke imininingwane yomsindo othunyelwe yiwebhusayithi.
strings.Downloads I resume myself: run this many: Ukulayisha ngezansi ngiphinde ngiqhubeke: sebenzisa lokhu okuningi ngasikhathi sinye eduze kwe-queues (0 = balinde i-queue slot)
strings.When the app starts, remove finished dow: Xa izinhlelo ziqala, susa ukulayisha phezulu okuqediwe lapho ifayela lisuswa noma lishiywa khona
strings.Settings, the download list and unfinish: Izilungiselelo, uhlu lokulayisha ngezansi kanye nezingxenye ezingaqediwe zigcinwa ngaphakathi
strings.The data moves the next time the app sta: I-data ihamba ngesikhathi esilandelayo i-app iqala. Konke kukopiwe futhi kuhlolwe ngaphambi kokuba ikopi elisha lisuse.
strings.Choose a folder that is not inside the c: Khetha ifolda engekho ngaphakathi kwefolda yedatha yamanje (noma enye indlela).
strings.Put a range in square brackets: [001-100: Faka umkhawulo kuma-square brackets: [001-100] igcina ama-digits amathathu, [1-100] ayisebenzi, [a-z] isebenzisa ama-letters futhi [0-100:5] ibala ngama-fives. Uhlu kuma-brackets, {jpg,png}, luzama ngalinye. Ama-range amaningi aphindaphindwa.
strings.Words find links that contain them; * an: Amagama athola amakhonkco aqukethe lawo; * ne? yizinhlamvu ezingenalutho; ukuqala! kushiya amakhonkco ngaphandle. Umzekelo: *.jpg!*thumb *
